title: $200 Individual Power Outage Support Grant Far West Region Oct 2024 – Guidelines
summary: This page provides guidelines for the $200 Individual Power Outage Support Grant for the Far West Region following the October 2024 storm.
who_can_apply: Residing in the Impacted Area on 17 October 2024 (the date of the Disaster Event).

Being in a Fly-In-Fly-Out (FIFO) work arrangement on 17 October 2024, and that arrangement requires you to live and work in the Impacted Area, even if your primary residence is outside the Impacted Area.

more_info.text: Request an Internal Review of a grant decision

external_links.text: Far West Region Storm from 17 October 2024 (AGRN 1149)

internal_links.text: Request an Internal Review of a grant decision

faqs.q: How much is the support grant?
faqs.a: A one-off payment of $200 will be made to eligible individuals.

faqs.q: Who is eligible for the grant?
faqs.a: You must either reside in the Impacted Area on 17 October 2024, or be in a Fly-In-Fly-Out (FIFO) work arrangement that requires you to live and work in the Impacted Area on that date.

faqs.q: When can I apply for the grant?
faqs.a: Applications will be accepted starting 7 November 2024 and will close on 31 March 2025.
